      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deleting runtime service flag demotion is a mechanical consequence of loading snapshots before P2P networking starts."
    },

      "name": "rpc",

      "rationale": "Eliminates major architectural and concurrency hazards in chainstate management by loading snapshots at node startup before networking and mempool setup. As noted in the description, loading at startup 'removes runtime activation checks, temporary import cache resizing and service demotion' while defending against race conditions from concurrent block arrivals."
